MUS.note: Mentions suspected AI-generated audio but states no rule or authority on AI harms.

systems.system: Computer Emergency Response Team of Mauritius

MUS.note: CERT-MU only asked platforms to remove accounts; no incident handled or alert stated.
No government IT staff or systems stated.

facts.fact: The regulator ICTA directed all internet service providers on 31 October 2024 to suspend access to social media platforms until 11 November 2024, and Emtel and Mauritius Telecom blocked TikTok, X and YouTube, with the directive reversed on 2 November.
